trials.label: r1c1
trials.name: reference hedged net
trials.hypothesis: The world-2 reference net, unchanged. It reads the mask and writes the placement logits under 4 layouts: as is, transposed, y-flipped and x-flipped. It tests whether one of these simple action-layout deviations is present here. If it scores 0 in training while a wider hedge scores above 0, the deviation lies outside these 4 layouts. If every candidate scores 0, the deviation is not about layout.

trials.label: r1c2
trials.name: 16-layout wide hedge
trials.hypothesis: This extends the reference net's 4-layout hedge to 16 layouts: 4 action orders (TYX, TXY, YXT, XYT) times 4 flip sets (none, y, x, both). The same layouts apply to the mask inputs and the output maps, all at full scale and summed. It targets an action layout that differs from the description. If it scores 0 in training while the 4-layout reference scores above 0, the extra layouts only add noise. If both score 0, the deviation is not the action layout.

trials.label: r1c3
trials.name: reference with 5x5 head conv
trials.hypothesis: Same as the reference net, but the head's 3x3 conv becomes 5x5. A placement logit can then see a 2-cell offset in any direction, which hedges against footprints larger than described or anchors other than top-left (centre or bottom-right). It is refuted if it scores no better than the reference, either both 0 or within about 0.07.

trials.label: r1c4
trials.name: DONE-index hedge
trials.hypothesis: Bets that DONE may sit at index 0 with placements shifted by one. The mask is read and the logits written under both offsets (DONE last and DONE first), each crossed with the 4 reference layouts. Both full logit vectors, each with its own DONE head, are summed. It is refuted if it scores 0 while the reference scores above 0, or if it gives no gain when both score 0.

trials.label: r1c5
trials.name: obs-symmetry hedge
trials.hypothesis: Bets that the obs is transposed or flipped relative to the action grid in ways the mask hedge cannot align, for example obs transposed while the actions are also flipped. The stem receives the obs as is, y-flipped, x-flipped and, on square grids, transposed, alongside the 4-layout mask and output hedge. The 1x1 stem learns which view to use. It is refuted if it scores no better than the reference.

trials.label: r1c6
trials.name: dense action-remap hedge
trials.hypothesis: Bets on an arbitrary permutation of action indices that no grid symmetry captures. A Linear embedding of the whole mask is fed into the stem, and a dense Linear from head features to all logits is added. Both use default (non-zero) init and are summed at full scale with the 4-layout conv hedge. Earlier dense heads were zero-initialised and used alone, which differs here. It is refuted if it scores no better than the reference.

trials.label: r2c1
trials.name: obs memory-layout hedge
trials.hypothesis: Adds two obs views that re-read the obs memory as channel-last (Y,X,C and X,Y,C), plus a Linear embedding of the flat obs. These go alongside the generic layout-matched mask hedge (16 full layouts, compact anchors, dense fallback). It targets an obs tensor whose memory order is scrambled, which flips and transposes cannot fix. Refuted if training success stays 0 while other candidates rise, or if all stay 0.

trials.label: r2c2
trials.name: wrap-around + global context
trials.hypothesis: All 3x3 convs use circular padding (coordinate channels still mark the edges), and a pooled global vector is broadcast back into every cell before the second residual block. Both sit on the generic layout-matched mask hedge. This targets a toroidal world, where footprints wrap at the edges, and dynamics that depend on far-away cells, which local zero-padded convs cannot express. Refuted if training success stays 0.

trials.label: r2c3
trials.name: full hedge, 2 epochs
trials.hypothesis: A kitchen-sink net that sums every untested hedge at full scale: generic layout matching (16 full layouts, compact anchors), DONE first or last, obs channel-last re-reads, flat-obs and dense mask embeddings, a dense output path, global broadcast, and footprint pools with top-left and bottom-right anchors. The goal is to escape zero first and ablate later. Refuted if training success stays 0, which would point to a deviation in dynamics or reward that no input or output hedge can fix.

trials.label: r2c4
trials.name: full hedge, 1 epoch
trials.hypothesis: The same kitchen-sink hedge as the 2-epoch candidate, but with ppo_epochs 1, which gives about 1.75x more environment samples (~266k steps against ~152k). The full hedge costs r≈1.6, so it may be sample-starved, and an exact build (+1) may be too rare to learn from at the lower count. If this scores above 0 while the 2-epoch version stays at 0, samples are the bottleneck. If both stay at 0, the deviation is not one of these hedges.

trials.label: r2c5
trials.name: footprint-pooled features + mask hedge
trials.hypothesis: After a learned projection, trunk features are max- and avg-pooled over each spec footprint, with both top-left and bottom-right anchors. These pooled features are concatenated into the head that feeds all 16 layout-matched outputs. This differs from the starting net, which pools but never reads the mask, and from the reference, which reads the mask but does not pool. It bets that this world is just harder and that direct footprint statistics speed learning. Refuted if training success stays 0.

trials.label: r2c6
trials.name: geometry hedge (wrap, 5x5, pools)
trials.hypothesis: Hedges the geometry together: circular padding (wrap-around), a 5x5 head (shifted anchors, larger footprints), footprint pools with both anchors, global broadcast, and DONE first or last, on the layout-matched mask hedge. Because r≈1.75, it uses 1 PPO epoch to keep about 240k steps. It targets geometry or dynamics that differ from the description in ways no single round-1 hedge combined. Refuted if training success stays 0.

trials.label: r3c1
trials.name: frame hedge: D4 views + shared cell remap
trials.hypothesis: Each obs channel is offered under all 8 grid symmetries; r1c5 only had 4 and no rotations. Shared learned Linear(P,P) remaps are added on obs cells, on mask cells and on the output maps, at full scale and summed with the 4-layout reference paths. Targets obs channels rotated, or cells scrambled, relative to the action frame. Training success staying at 0 refutes it.

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.002, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.002, "gamma": 0.9, "gae_lambda": 0.85}

STEM = 64
WIDTH = 40
HP = 32
HK = 3
MEMB = 8
LAYOUTS = [("TYX", ()), ("TXY", ()), ("TYX", (2,)), ("TYX", (3,))]
D4 = True
REMAP = True
LNORM = False
SEP_CRITIC = False
DILATE = [1, 1]
GBCAST = False
LAYER_ENC = False
LE_IN = 18
LE_HID = 32
LE_OUT = 16
CR_W = 32


def to_grid(v, order, flips, T, Y, X):
    B = v.shape[0]
    if order == "TYX":
        g = v.reshape(B, T, Y, X)
    else:
        g = v.reshape(B, T, X, Y).transpose(2, 3)
    if len(flips) > 0:
        g = g.flip(list(flips))
    return g


def from_grid(m, order, flips):
    if len(flips) > 0:
        m = m.flip(list(flips))
    if order == "TYX":
        out = m
    else:
        out = m.transpose(2, 3)
    return out.reshape(m.shape[0], -1)


def coords(obs, Y, X):
    B = obs.shape[0]
    ys = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, Y, 1).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
    xs = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, 1, X).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
    return torch.cat([ys, xs], dim=1)


def sym_views(t, square):
    vs = [t, t.flip([2]), t.flip([3]), t.flip([2, 3])]
    if square:
        tt = t.transpose(2, 3)
        vs = vs + [tt, tt.flip([2]), tt.flip([3]), tt.flip([2, 3])]
    return vs


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.P = self.Y * self.X
        self.C = int(spec.in_channels)
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        self.n_actions = int(spec.n_actions)
        self.grid_ok = (self.n_place == self.T * self.P) and (self.n_actions == self.n_place + 1)
        self.square = self.Y == self.X
        self.nviews = 1
        if D4:
            self.nviews = 8 if self.square else 4
        self.layer_ok = LAYER_ENC and (self.C == 4 * self.Z + 3)
        cin = self.C * self.nviews + 2
        if REMAP:
            self.obs_remap = nn.Linear(self.P, self.P)
            cin += self.C
        if self.grid_ok:
            cin += len(LAYOUTS) * self.T
            if REMAP:
                self.mask_remap = nn.Linear(self.P, self.P)
                cin += self.T
        else:
            self.mask_embed = nn.Linear(self.n_actions, MEMB * self.P)
            cin += MEMB
        if self.layer_ok:
            self.le1 = nn.Conv2d(LE_IN, LE_HID, 1)
            self.le2 = nn.Conv2d(LE_HID, LE_OUT, 3, padding=1)
            cin += 2 * LE_OUT
        self.stem1 = nn.Conv2d(cin, STEM, 1)
        if LNORM:
            self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(STEM)
        self.stem2 = nn.Conv2d(STEM, WIDTH, 1)
        self.res = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=d, dilation=d) for d in DILATE])
        if GBCAST:
            self.gb = nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, WIDTH)
        self.hconv = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, HP, HK, padding=HK // 2)
        self.hskip = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, HP, 1)
        if self.grid_ok:
            self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HP, self.T, 1) for _ in LAYOUTS])
            if REMAP:
                self.out_r = nn.Conv2d(HP, self.T, 1)
                self.out_remap = nn.Linear(self.P, self.P)
        else:
            self.out_proj = nn.Conv2d(HP, 4, 1)
            self.out_lin = nn.Linear(4 * self.P, self.n_actions - 1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        if SEP_CRITIC:
            self.cr1 = nn.Conv2d(cin, CR_W, 1)
            self.cr2 = nn.Conv2d(CR_W, CR_W, 3, padding=1)
            self.crg = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * CR_W, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def layer_feats(self, obs):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        Y, X, Z = self.Y, self.X, self.Z
        g = obs[:, :4 * Z].reshape(B, 4, Z, Y, X)
        dn = F.pad(g, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))[:, :, :Z]
        up = F.pad(g, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))[:, :, 1:]
        gl = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(2).expand(B, 3, Z, Y, X)
        zp = torch.linspace(0.0, 1.0, Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, 1, Z, Y, X)
        cc = coords(obs, Y, X).unsqueeze(2).expand(B, 2, Z, Y, X)
        u = torch.cat([g, dn, up, gl, zp, cc], dim=1)
        u = u.permute(0, 2, 1, 3, 4).reshape(B * Z, LE_IN, Y, X)
        v = F.relu(self.le2(F.relu(self.le1(u))))
        v = v.view(B, Z, LE_OUT, Y, X)
        return torch.cat([v.amax(1), v.mean(1)], dim=1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        Y, X, P, T = self.Y, self.X, self.P, self.T
        m = mask.float()
        if self.nviews > 1:
            parts = sym_views(obs, self.square)
        else:
            parts = [obs]
        parts.append(coords(obs, Y, X))
        if REMAP:
            parts.append(self.obs_remap(obs.reshape(B, self.C, P)).view(B, self.C, Y, X))
        if self.grid_ok:
            mp = m[:, :self.n_place]
            for o, fl in LAYOUTS:
                parts.append(to_grid(mp, o, fl, T, Y, X))
            if REMAP:
                parts.append(self.mask_remap(mp.reshape(B, T, P)).view(B, T, Y, X))
        else:
            parts.append(self.mask_embed(m).view(B, MEMB, Y, X))
        if self.layer_ok:
            parts.append(self.layer_feats(obs))
        inp = torch.cat(parts, dim=1)
        s = self.stem1(inp)
        if LNORM:
            s = self.ln(s.permute(0, 2, 3, 1)).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)
        x = F.relu(self.stem2(F.relu(s)))
        for i, conv in enumerate(self.res):
            x = F.relu(x + conv(x))
            if GBCAST and i == 0:
                x = x + self.gb(torch.cat([x.mean((2, 3)), x.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))[:, :, None, None]
        f = x
        h = F.relu(self.hconv(f) + self.hskip(f))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        if self.grid_ok:
            place = 0
            for k, (o, fl) in enumerate(LAYOUTS):
                place = place + from_grid(self.outs[k](h), o, fl)
            if REMAP:
                place = place + self.out_remap(self.out_r(h).reshape(B, T, P)).reshape(B, -1)
        else:
            place = self.out_lin(self.out_proj(h).flatten(1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        if SEP_CRITIC:
            c = F.relu(self.cr1(inp))
            c = F.relu(c + self.cr2(c))
            v = self.value_head(self.crg(torch.cat([c.mean((2, 3)), c.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)))
        else:
            v = self.value_head(g)
        return logits, v.squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

        self.Z = int(spec.Z)

        self.layer_ok = LAYER_ENC and (self.C == 4 * self.Z + 3)

        if REMAP:
            self.obs_remap = nn.Linear(self.P, self.P)
            cin += self.C
        if self.grid_ok:
            cin += len(LAYOUTS) * self.T
            if REMAP:
                self.mask_remap = nn.Linear(self.P, self.P)
                cin += self.T
        else:
            self.mask_embed = nn.Linear(self.n_actions, MEMB * self.P)
            cin += MEMB
        if self.layer_ok:
            self.le1 = nn.Conv2d(LE_IN, LE_HID, 1)
            self.le2 = nn.Conv2d(LE_HID, LE_OUT, 3, padding=1)
            cin += 2 * LE_OUT
        self.stem1 = nn.Conv2d(cin, STEM, 1)

import torch

import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.002, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.01, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
WIDTH = 40
HP = 32
HK = 3
MEMB = 8
LAYOUTS = [("TYX", ()), ("TXY", ()), ("TYX", (2,)), ("TYX", (3,))]
D4 = False
REMAP = False
LNORM = False
SEP_CRITIC = True
DILATE = [1, 1]

LAYER_ENC = False
LE_IN = 18
LE_HID = 32

def to_grid(v, order, flips, T, Y, X):
    B = v.shape[0]
    if order == "TYX":
        g = v.reshape(B, T, Y, X)
    else:
        g = v.reshape(B, T, X, Y).transpose(2, 3)

                parts.append(to_grid(mp, o, fl, T, Y, X))
            if REMAP:
                parts.append(self.mask_remap(mp.reshape(B, T, P)).view(B, T, Y, X))
        else:
            parts.append(self.mask_embed(m).view(B, MEMB, Y, X))
        if self.layer_ok:
            parts.append(self.layer_feats(obs))
        inp = torch.cat(parts, dim=1)
        s = self.stem1(inp)
        if LNORM:
            s = self.ln(s.permute(0, 2, 3, 1)).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)
        x = F.relu(self.stem2(F.relu(s)))
        for i, conv in enumerate(self.res):
            x = F.relu(x + conv(x))
            if GBCAST and i == 0:
                x = x + self.gb(torch.cat([x.mean((2, 3)), x.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))[:, :, None, None]
        f = x
        h = F.relu(self.hconv(f) + self.hskip(f))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        if self.grid_ok:
            place = 0
            for k, (o, fl) in enumerate(LAYOUTS):
                place = place + from_grid(self.outs[k](h), o, fl)
            if REMAP:
                place = place + self.out_remap(self.out_r(h).reshape(B, T, P)).reshape(B, -1)
        else:
            place = self.out_lin(self.out_proj(h).flatten(1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        if SEP_CRITIC:
            c = F.relu(self.cr1(inp))
            c = F.relu(c + self.cr2(c))
            v = self.value_head(self.crg(torch.cat([c.mean((2, 3)), c.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)))
        else:
            v = self.value_head(g)
        return logits, v.squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

trials.label: r4c1
trials.name: conv trunk + cell self-attention
trials.hypothesis: Adds two self-attention blocks over the 64 cell tokens of the reference trunk, with a learned position embedding per cell, before the 4-layout head. Uses 1 PPO epoch to keep about 240k steps. It targets obs cells paired with action cells in a way no symmetry or local conv captures, and dynamics that act over long distances. Refuted if training success stays 0.

trials.label: r4c2
trials.name: global MLP logit path
trials.hypothesis: Adds a two-layer MLP from the flat obs and the whole mask straight to all logits, DONE included. It has default init, runs at full scale and is summed with the 4-layout reference logits. Unlike r1c6, it reads the raw obs and mask jointly, not conv features. It targets an arbitrary correspondence between obs, mask and action indices, or between grid and action count. Refuted if training success stays 0.

trials.label: r4c3
trials.name: wider deeper reference, 1 epoch
trials.hypothesis: The reference hedge net with a wider trunk (stem 64, width 48) and three residual 3x3 blocks (dilations 1, 1, 2), trained with 1 PPO epoch. Each update now takes 64x8 steps so the short check gets at least 4 updates. It targets a capacity or receptive-field bottleneck combined with too few samples. Refuted if training success stays at 0, as for every earlier candidate.

trials.label: r4c4
trials.name: mask-free input, pool + layout head
trials.hypothesis: Bets that the mask is corrupt, offset or misleading, so every mask-fed trunk so far learned from bad input. The mask is dropped as an input. The policy reads only the obs, through the reference trunk, and its logits sum the starting net's footprint-pool head with the 4-layout output hedge. Differs from the starting net in the layout hedge, the coordinates and the recipe. Refuted if training success stays 0.

trials.label: r4c5
trials.name: orthogonal init, big batch
trials.hypothesis: The reference net with standard PPO orthogonal init: gain √2 on hidden layers, 0.01 on all policy outputs equally, and 1 on the value head. Paired with large 4096-sample updates, 1 epoch (about 425k steps) and entropy 0.01. It targets early policy collapse and noisy small-batch updates in a world that is valid but harder. r3c2 used default init and small batches. Refuted if training success stays 0.

trials.label: r4c6
trials.name: attention + global MLP + pools, 1 epoch
trials.hypothesis: Sums this round's new hedges at full scale in one net: a cell self-attention block with learned positions, the flat obs+mask MLP logit path and the starting net's footprint-pool head, all on the 4-layout mask hedge. Uses 1 epoch (r about 1.8, about 230k steps). It is a last-round escape attempt: any nonzero result points to arbitrary cell or action pairings. Refuted if training success stays 0.

analyses.1: There are no results yet. The starting architecture scored 0 on the shared seed. Earlier searches show that a uniform 0 means the world differs from its description. In those worlds, only the reference net with layout hedging ever scored above 0, at about 0.22. Nothing is ruled out yet. A 1x1 stem already handles any reordering of obs channels, so that bet is redundant. Round 1 follows the program: the reference net, a 16-layout hedge, a 5x5 head conv, a hedge on the DONE index, and a hedge on how the obs is laid out spatially. The sixth candidate adds a dense, layout-free term to the action layout. It is summed with the structured hedge at full scale, which has not been tested before. All candidates keep the reference recipe and r near 1. Each file falls back to a Linear embedding if n_place != T*Y*X. Any nonzero training success will set round 2's direction.
analyses.2:
All six round-1 trials scored 0 on dev and in training, as did the starting net. Each ran on one seed, so this is weak evidence. It points away from these deviations: the simple 4-layout and full 16-layout action orders (8 grid symmetries times type-major or type-minor), anchors within 2 cells, DONE at index 0, obs flipped or transposed relative to the actions, and a learned dense remap. The 16-layout hedge also covers any obs flip or transpose relative to the actions, so obs symmetry views are redundant.

Still untested: a placement count other than T*Y*X (for example, only in-grid anchors). If it differs, every round-1 net fell back to a slow dense head, which would explain the uniform zeros. Also untested: obs memory-layout reinterpretation, wrap-around or non-local dynamics, footprint-pooled features combined with mask inputs, and sample-limited learning.

Every candidate now matches action layouts generically: 16 full-grid layouts, compact-anchor layouts, and a dense fallback. Each then adds one bet, and two kitchen-sink nets try to escape zero first.
analyses.3: After 12 trials, dev and training success are both exactly 0, so the deviation is still unfound. Parameter counts confirm the spec: T=4, an 8x8 grid, Z=6, n_place=256 and n_actions=257, so a wrong action count or grid size is ruled out. The 1x1 stem absorbs any reordering of obs channels, so permuted channels are ruled out for every net. The results also rule out these deviations: the 16 action-layout symmetries, DONE first or last, the obs flipped or transposed as a whole, channel-last memory reads, anchor shifts of 1-2 cells, wrap-around edges, and dense mask remaps that are not shared. Sample counts of 150-260k steps with 1 or 2 PPO epochs also stayed at 0. Still untested: rotations of single channels; cell scrambles that a shared P×P remap could learn; obs scale (handled by LayerNorm after the stem conv); value loss swamping the policy (separate critic, long horizon); dynamics that act over long distances (dilated convs); and height reasoning that shares weights across layers. Each is a separate bet, and one candidate combines them.
